local Players = game:GetService("Players")

        screenGui:Destroy()
    end
end

if isVoiceEnabled then baseOffsetX = baseOffsetX + 45 end

local topbarContainer = Instance.new("Frame")

topbarContainer.BackgroundTransparency = 1
topbarContainer.Parent = screenGui

local toggleBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")

Instance.new("UICorner", toggleBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)

settingsBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2

settingsBtn.TextScaled = true

Instance.new("UICorner", settingsBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)

local function addStroke(gui)
    local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150)
    stroke.Thickness = 1.2
    stroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
    stroke.Parent = gui
end
addStroke(toggleBtn)
addStroke(settingsBtn)

-- 4. Dragging Helper Logic
local function makeDraggable(frame, triggerObjects, conditionFunc)
    local dragging, dragStart, startPos
    for _, obj in ipairs(triggerObjects) do
        obj.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
            if conditionFunc() and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
                dragging = true
                dragStart = input.Position
                startPos = frame.Position
            end
        end)
    end
    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
            local delta = input.Position - dragStart
            frame.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
        end
    end)
    UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging = false
        end
    end)
end

-- 5. Settings Panel
local settingsPanel = Instance.new("Frame")

settingsPanel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 250, 0, 270)
settingsPanel.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -125, 0.4, -135)
settingsPanel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 25)
settingsPanel.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1

local setPadding = Instance.new("UIPadding")

setPadding.Parent = settingsPanel

setLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20)

setLabel.Text = "Inventory Settings"
setLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
setLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Code
setLabel.TextSize = 18
setLabel.Parent = settingsPanel

    local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
    frame.Size = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, 30)
    frame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    frame.Parent = settingsPanel
    
    local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    label.Size = UDim2.new(0.7, 0, 1, 0)
    label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    label.Text = text
    label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
    label.Font = Enum.Font.Code
    label.TextSize = 14
    label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    label.Parent = frame
    
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    btn.Size = UDim2.new(0.3, 0, 0.8, 0)
    btn.Position = UDim2.new(0.7, 0, 0.1, 0)
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 50, 50)
    btn.Text = "OFF"
    btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    btn.Font = Enum.Font.Code
    btn.Parent = frame
    Instance.new("UICorner", btn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
    
    local state = false
    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        state = not state
        btn.BackgroundColor3 = state and Color3.fromRGB(50, 150, 50) or Color3.fromRGB(150, 50, 50)
        btn.Text = state and "ON" or "OFF"
        callback(state)
    end)
end

local function createCounter(labelName, getVal, setVal, minVal, maxVal)
    local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
    frame.Size = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, 30)
    frame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    frame.Parent = settingsPanel
    
    local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    label.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 0)
    label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    label.Text = labelName
    label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
    label.Font = Enum.Font.Code
    label.TextSize = 14
    label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    label.Parent = frame
    
    local minusBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    minusBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.12, 0, 0.8, 0)
    minusBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.55, 0, 0.1, 0)
    minusBtn.Text = "-"
    minusBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 50)
    minusBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    minusBtn.Parent = frame
    Instance.new("UICorner", minusBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
    
    local valLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    valLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0.18, 0, 0.8, 0)
    valLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0.68, 0, 0.1, 0)
    valLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    valLabel.Text = tostring(getVal())
    valLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    valLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Code
    valLabel.TextSize = 14

    local plusBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")

    plusBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.87, 0, 0.1, 0)

    plusBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 50)
    plusBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    plusBtn.Parent = frame
    Instance.new("UICorner", plusBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)

    minusBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        local current = getVal()
        if current > minVal then
            setVal(current - 1)
            valLabel.Text = tostring(getVal())
            if renderUI then renderUI() end
        end
    end)

    plusBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        local current = getVal()
        if current < maxVal then
            setVal(current + 1)
            valLabel.Text = tostring(getVal())
            if renderUI then renderUI() end
        end
    end)
end

-- Revert Button Inside Settings

if _G.AntiBang_Shutdown then
    pcall(_G.AntiBang_Shutdown)

local Players          = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService       = game:GetService("RunService")
local StarterGui       = game:GetService("StarterGui")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

-- {{ toggle }}

local CONFIG = {
    ENABLED = true, -- turn anti off or on (use true or false)
}

local NOTIFY = true -- notify if it succeeded (use true or false)

local function getTorso(char)
    if not char then return nil end
    return char:FindFirstChild("Torso")
        or char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
        or char:FindFirstChild("LowerTorso")
        or char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end

local function getRoot(char)
    if not char then return nil end
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    return (hum and hum.RootPart) or char.PrimaryPart
end

local function notify(title, text)
    if not NOTIFY then return end
    pcall(function()
        StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification", {
            Title = title, Text = text, Duration = 3
        })
    end)
end

local function matchesBangFingerprint(plr, myTorso)
    local theirChar = plr.Character
    if not theirChar then return false end

    local theirHRP = theirChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not theirHRP then return false end

    local localOffset = myTorso.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(theirHRP.Position)

    if math.abs(localOffset.X) > 0.25 then return false end
    if math.abs(localOffset.Y) > 0.25 then return false end
    if math.abs(localOffset.Z - 1.1) > 0.25 then return false end

    local dot = theirHRP.CFrame.LookVector:Dot(myTorso.CFrame.LookVector)
    if dot < 0.995 then return false end

    return true
end

local dipBusy = false
local function voidDip()
    if dipBusy then return end
    local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not myChar then return end
    local root = getRoot(myChar)
    if not root or not root.Parent then return end

    dipBusy = true
    local savedCF = root.CFrame
    local savedDH = workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight

    workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight = -1e9

    local t0 = tick()
    pcall(function()
        while tick() - t0 < 0.15 do
            if not root.Parent then break end
            root.CFrame                  = CFrame.new(0, -800, 0)
            root.AssemblyLinearVelocity  = Vector3.zero
            root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
            task.wait()
        end
    end)

    if root.Parent then
        root.AssemblyLinearVelocity  = Vector3.zero
        root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
        root.CFrame                  = savedCF
        local hum = myChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum then hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp) end
    end

    task.wait()
    workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight = savedDH
    dipBusy = false
end

local confirmCount = {}
local lastAction   = 0

local steppedConn = RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
    if not CONFIG.ENABLED then return end
    if dipBusy then return end

    local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not myChar then return end
    local myTorso = getTorso(myChar)
    if not myTorso then return end

    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr ~= LocalPlayer and plr.Character then
            if matchesBangFingerprint(plr, myTorso) then
                confirmCount[plr] = (confirmCount[plr] or 0) + 1

                if confirmCount[plr] >= 5 then
                    confirmCount[plr] = 0

                    if tick() - lastAction < 1.5 then
                        return
                    end
                    lastAction = tick()

                    notify("Anti-Bang", "Bang confirmed from " .. plr.Name)
                    voidDip()
                    return
                end
            else
                confirmCount[plr] = 0
            end
        end
    end
end)

local inputConn = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
    if processed then return end
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.RightControl then
        CONFIG.ENABLED = not CONFIG.ENABLED
        notify("Anti-Bang", CONFIG.ENABLED and "Enabled" or "Disabled")
    end
end)

local removeConn = Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(plr)
    confirmCount[plr] = nil
end)

local charConn = LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
    confirmCount = {}
    dipBusy      = false
end)

_G.AntiBang_Shutdown = function()
    steppedConn:Disconnect()
    inputConn:Disconnect()
    removeConn:Disconnect()
    charConn:Disconnect()
end

_G.AntiBang_Toggle = function(state)
    if type(state) == "boolean" then
        CONFIG.ENABLED = state
    else
        CONFIG.ENABLED = not CONFIG.ENABLED
    end
    notify("Anti-Bang", CONFIG.ENABLED and "Enabled" or "Disabled")
end

	local function SetLocked(part, boolean) _({"SetLocked", {part}, boolean}) end

			return

		if skyPart.Position.Y < 100 then

			SetAnchor(skyPart, true)
		end
	end)

local Rayfield = loadstring(game:HttpGet('https://sirius.menu/rayfield'))()

local Window = Rayfield:CreateWindow({
   Name = "Fly Hub | Rayfield",
   LoadingTitle = "Rayfield Fly Script",
   LoadingSubtitle = "by Fly Hub",
   ConfigurationSaving = {
      Enabled = false
   },
   Discord = {
      Enabled = false
   },
   KeySystem = false
})

-- Variables
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

local flying = false
local speed = 50
local walkSpeedValue = 16
local bodyVelocity, bodyGyro

-- Fly Functions
local function startFlying()
	local character = player.Character
	if not character then return end
	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not root or not humanoid then return end

	humanoid.PlatformStand = true

	bodyVelocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
	bodyVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1) * 100000
	bodyVelocity.Velocity = Vector3.zero
	bodyVelocity.Parent = root

	bodyGyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
	bodyGyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1) * 100000
	bodyGyro.CFrame = root.CFrame
	bodyGyro.Parent = root

	flying = true
end

local function stopFlying()
	flying = false
	if bodyVelocity then bodyVelocity:Destroy() end
	if bodyGyro then bodyGyro:Destroy() end

	local character = player.Character
	if character then
		local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if humanoid then
			humanoid.PlatformStand = false
		end
	end
end

-- WalkSpeed Loop (Keeps WalkSpeed set continuously)
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	local character = player.Character
	if character then
		local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if humanoid and not flying then
			humanoid.WalkSpeed = walkSpeedValue
		end
	end
end)

-- RenderStepped Fly Movement Loop (Works with WASD & Mobile Joystick)
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	if flying and player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
		local root = player.Character.HumanoidRootPart
		local humanoid = player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

		bodyGyro.CFrame = camera.CFrame

		local moveDir = humanoid and humanoid.MoveDirection or Vector3.zero
		if moveDir.Magnitude > 0 then
			bodyVelocity.Velocity = camera.CFrame.LookVector * (moveDir.Magnitude * speed)
		else
			bodyVelocity.Velocity = Vector3.zero
		end
	end
end)

local FlyToggle = MainTab:CreateToggle({
   Name = "Enable Fly",

   Flag = "FlyToggle",

      if Value then

      else

      end
   end,
